_why: Written by loop/footage_lane.py on every host that runs a harvester, keyed by the harvester's path. A host that does NOT run a harvester reads this to verify the host that does is doing it: a success inside harvest.delegated_max_age_days (loop/config.json) is fresh; a failed run inside the cap is DELEGATED_HARVEST_FAILING; nothing inside the cap is DELEGATED_HARVEST_STALE. The video manifest never enters git (the clips are on the Mac and in R2, and V11 re-hashes every record against the bytes on disk), so `records` here is how the cloud knows the pool size.
